summary:
edX is the online-course site at edx.org. The “X” mark in the tab is the icon course bookmarks use, saved from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against edx.org. HTML came from https://www.edx.org/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 16x16 → https://www.edx.org/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.edx.org/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 26283 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 256×256.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #002222 comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-256x256-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 8173 bytes) from https://www.edx.org/favicon.ico.
